subject.title: feat(plugin-sdk): generic outbound delivery-report seam; WhatsApp native auto-reply reports provider-accepted sends

question: Should OpenClaw accept `openclaw/plugin-sdk/outbound-delivery-report` as the public channel self-delivery reporting seam once real WhatsApp/runtime proof is supplied?
rationale: This is an additive but release-facing Plugin SDK contract, so automation should not decide the permanent API shape or semantics without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve seam after proof
options.body: Require redacted WhatsApp/runtime proof and then merge this generic, channel-agnostic reporting seam as the supported self-delivery API.

options.title: Revise the SDK shape
options.body: Keep the PR open but ask for a different name, narrower type shape, or different idempotency/session semantics before accepting the public contract.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Leave the linked issue as the design point if maintainers are not ready to own a public SDK reporting contract yet.

recommendation.title: Approve seam after proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted WhatsApp/runtime proof and then merge this generic, channel-agnostic reporting seam as the supported self-delivery API.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest current routing signal across the touched outbound/WhatsApp files and merged adjacent hook-contract PRs.
